description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ViewModulelistmenu' that extends 'SugarView' and is responsible for rendering a module list menu in the SuiteCRM application. It sets display options in the constructor and, in the 'display' method, retrieves recent tracker history for the current user, processes the items, and renders a Smarty template for the module list menu.

classes.name: ViewModulelistmenu
classes.description: A view class for displaying a module list menu with recent user activity in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes view options to not show title, header, footer, JavaScript, subpanels, or search, and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Retrieves recently viewed items for the current user, processes each item to generate summaries and images, assigns this data to the template, and renders the module list menu template.
